title: NFL Sunday Night Football Bets & Player Props: Eagles vs. Commanders Picks (Week 8)
transcript_summary: Chris Welsh and Scott Bogman preview the Week 8 Sunday Night Football matchup between the Philadelphia Eagles and Washington Commanders for BettingPros. They analyze line movements, team health, prop bets for Rachaad White, Antonio Williams, and Dallas Goedert, build a three-leg parlay of the week, and provide final score predictions.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chris Welsh
speaker_segments.text: Welcome into BettingPros! This is the Week 8 Sunday Night Football betting preview. I'm Chris Welsh, that's Scott Bogman, and we're taking a look at Eagles versus Commanders.

speaker_segments.speaker: Scott Bogman
speaker_segments.text: Come on Welsh, these guys combined to be 3-9-1. That's great for a primetime game, isn't it?

speaker_segments.speaker: Chris Welsh
speaker_segments.text: We've got a quarterback that's never played, a quarterback with 1.5 arms. It's exactly what we wanted.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chris Welsh
speaker_segments.text: Let's take a look at the lines: Philly is at Washington. Washington -6.5 favorite at home, total 40.5, Commanders -228 moneyline, Eagles +228.

speaker_segments.speaker: Scott Bogman
speaker_segments.text: I would prefer something different as the night game. I'm surprised the Commanders are favored by 6.5 points. Down bad Philly might still be better than Washington.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chris Welsh
speaker_segments.text: If there's one full agreement, it is that the over is in play at 40.5. Also, the Eagles on the moneyline at almost +228 is an interesting play if Devonta Smith is active.

speaker_segments.speaker: Scott Bogman
speaker_segments.text: I'll take Philly on the moneyline regardless of whether Devonta Smith plays or not. I don't trust Washington's defense at all.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chris Welsh
speaker_segments.text: All right, so our plays are going to be Philly on the moneyline. Let's talk about some props after a word from Polymarket.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chris Welsh
speaker_segments.text: Trade on Polymarket, the prediction market for sports. Use code FPPOD for a $25 bonus when you deposit $10.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chris Welsh
speaker_segments.text: Let's talk about props. I am wildly interested in Dallas Goedert props because the Commanders defense struggles against tight ends.

speaker_segments.speaker: Scott Bogman
speaker_segments.text: I'm interested in Macai Lemon receiving props if he's out there and Smith or Wicks are out.

speaker_segments.speaker: Scott Bogman
speaker_segments.text: For Prop 1, I'm going Over 2.5 receptions for Rachaad White at +118. He had 46 snaps last game, 4 receptions.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chris Welsh
speaker_segments.text: I'll join you on Rachaad White Over 11.5 receiving yards at -114. When he hits this, he smashes it.

speaker_segments.speaker: Scott Bogman
speaker_segments.text: For Prop 2, Antonio Williams Over 33.5 receiving yards at -112. Philly allowed the 5th most receptions to wide receivers.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chris Welsh
speaker_segments.text: My second prop is Dallas Goedert Anytime Touchdown at +220. Washington graded 28th out of 32 against TEs and gave up 8 TDs in 6 games.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chris Welsh
speaker_segments.text: Let's build our Parlay of the Week with Parlay Wizard: Antonio Williams Over 33.5 Rec Yards, Dallas Goedert Anytime TD, and Rachaad White Over 2.5 Rec at +985.

speaker_segments.speaker: Scott Bogman
speaker_segments.text: My final score prediction is Eagles 23, Commanders 20. Give me Philly to win.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chris Welsh
speaker_segments.text: My final score prediction is Eagles 24, Commanders 20. Over 40.5 hits, Eagles win on the moneyline.

speaker_segments.speaker: Chris Welsh
speaker_segments.text: Download the BettingPros app to track your bets and check out all our tools. Good luck in Sunday Night Football!
